CVE-2026-123007: Critical NGINX HTTP/2 Integer Underflow Leads to RCE (FIXED)
item.description: Overview Today, both Rapid7 and F5 are disclosing CVE-2026-123007 , a critical integer underflow vulnerability affecting nginx HTTP/2, which can allow for unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) against affected servers under certain conditions. item.title: ClamAV Vulnerabilities Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
item.description: Multiple vulnerabilities in ClamAV could allow a remote attacker to bypass configured file and scan time limits and cause a denial of service (DoS) condition, interrupting scanning operations. For more information about these vulnerabilities, see the Details section of this advisory. For additional information on these vulnerabilities in ClamAV, see the ClamAV blog . Cisco has released software updates that address these vulnerabilities in affected Cisco platforms. There are no workarounds that address these vulnerabilities. item.title: Vulnerability in Oracle OpenJDK (Java4Shell) Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
item.description: On November 17, 2026, Oracle announced the availability of fixes for a vulnerability in OpenJDK that could lead to remote code execution identified by CVE-2026-114938. The vulnerability affects OpenJDK Java 17.0.6 and later on x86-64 platforms when processing Base64 encoded content. For more information, see the Oracle Critical Security Patch Update Advisory - November 2026 and the OpenJDK Vulnerability Advisory: 2026/11/17 .
